name: Thomas Massie
summary:
Thomas Harold Massie (born January 13, 1971) is an American politician and engineer. A libertarian Republican, Massie has been the United States representative for Kentucky's 4th congressional district since 2012.
Raised in Vanceburg, Kentucky, Massie earned two degrees from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, where he worked on computer simulation, including haptics and 3D human–computer interaction.
